name: Creature AI
description: Who fights whom, and rules with more than the game's kinds: Vukahs and Scavengers feud everywhere; the warden (a Vukah) ignores players and hunts Scavengers; the vukah caller summons two Vukahs and throws ice; a ranger fights for the players and leaves Vukahs that carry no weapon alone. Server side, game bodies: vanilla clients watch. Sample for docs/kiln/modding/npc-ai.md.
